body.summary: Moved the construction of the rpc and stream handler tables (from the session-purge pipeline through the understanding-route merge), with the offline-stub and step.call helpers, from main() into buildHandlerRuntime(deps) in src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts. deps carries db, configStore, queue, indexer and startedAt, plus three late-bound functions for things main() creates after the tables: shutdown, the server's attachedClients and the understanding service. A diff of the moved block against the original shows only those three reads changed; every handler body is otherwise byte-identical. main() calls the function with the real queue and indexer. Four source-scan tests that read handler code from index.ts now read handler-runtime.ts (titles unchanged). Run: the new key-set test, the 7 related daemon/MCP source and registry suites (40/40), and the MCP and step suites (499/499); the src/daemon directory suite was not completed, per the user's rule to run the full sweep once at the end.
